sentence: This project builds computerized models of where transcripts, proteins and metabolites are found in cells and tissues.
This project studies how the infant brain represents visual objects and compares it with artificial neural network models.
This project builds a device that uses light to make images of collagen and show where cancer cells end and healthy tissue begins.
This project designs a laser facility with two ultraintense lasers to study matter under extreme conditions.
This project builds imaging tools to study RNA molecules modified with glycans that sit on the cell surface.
This project studies whether striped and unstriped color morphs of the Eastern Red-backed Salamander respond differently to changing temperatures.
This project builds methods to analyze and defend the AI in autonomous cyber-physical systems against physical-layer attacks.
This project tries to find out how growth hormones and a core genetic module shape spikelets and inflorescence branches in Setaria viridis.
This project redesigns a college program so it teaches electronics, mechanics and automation together.
This project explores why weather forecasts lose accuracy between two weeks and one month, and how artificial intelligence may improve them.
This project studies reactive molecules called aryl diazonium ions and how they can report on the chemistry of living systems using fluorescence.
This project builds a mathematical framework to study the trade-off between validity and breadth in language generation by AI.
This project builds low-cost ear tags that use audio and electrical stimulation to keep livestock close to their herd.
This project uses machine learning to measure how process parameters in metal additive manufacturing affect the microstructure and surface of Inconel 718.
This project builds a flat array of coils that shapes a magnetic field to send wireless power to a device in any orientation.
